maria_support: Heads up — customer reported a subtle change in response detail after our last model rollout. They say answers are shorter and skip the mini-step explanations they used to get. Pasting their repro below.

elaine_support: Thanks — paste their prompt + before/after examples?

maria_support: Customer-provided prompt: `Describe how to reset a user's password for our web app, include steps and brief caveats.`

maria_support: Before (what they used to get):
```
1) Go to Settings > Account.
2) Click "Reset password" and enter email.
3) Check email for link, follow instructions.

Caveat: Password reset links expire in 24h. If email not received, check spam or contact support.
```

maria_support: After (what they're seeing now):
```
Click Settings > Reset password. Follow the link in your email.
```

maria_support: Customer included their request ID: `req_8f7b3a` and a curl repro.

maria_support: curl they ran:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-4.2.0","input":"Describe how to reset a user's password for our web app, include steps and brief caveats."}'
```

marco_eng: Noted. Which variant was rolled to prod? I saw a deploy but not the release notes for generation defaults.

ops_bot: deploy: rwd-4.2.0 rolled to prod at 2025-11-04T14:02:07Z by deploy-bot :white_check_mark:

jitendra_prod: We didn't intend to change content heuristics but rwd-4.2.0 included a kernel-level sampling patch. I'll diff config between 4.1.9 and 4.2.0 for sampling params (top_p, temperature, repetition_penalty, eos_bias).

elaine_support: Customer claims they didn't change the prompt or client-side wrapper. They're on hosted API, no proxying. Asking for an ETA on investigation.

marco_eng: Meanwhile, can support ask for 3 more request IDs and timestamps? Need to fetch full request/response pairs from logs. Also want the exact agent metadata: model header, any `system` or `assistant` prefixes in the payload.

maria_support: Got two more IDs: `req_8f7b3b`, `req_8f7b3c`. Times are ~2025-11-04T14:10Z and 14:18Z. Customer also attached the SDK call — they set `max_new_tokens: 256`, `temperature: 0.0`.

marco_eng: Temperature 0.0 should bias deterministic but not shorten by design. If `eos_bias` or `stop_token` behavior changed at kernel level it could truncate. I'll check whether we added an EOS clamp in 4.2.0.

jitendra_prod: I'll run an A/B: reproduce the same input against rwd-4.1.9 and rwd-4.2.0 with customer's headers. If we can reproduce length delta we can either revert the kernel change or patch the sampling defaults.

sre_bot: perf: 4.2.0 pod pool healthy, latency P95 within SLO, no error spikes in the time window.

maria_support: Customer is asking for either a rollback or mitigation. They said business workflows rely on the extra clarifying bullets.

marco_eng: If reproducible, short-term mitigation: force a higher `min_new_tokens` or include a small instruction in the prompt like "Provide 3 concise steps with one-sentence caveat." We should not recommend prompting workarounds as permanent fix.

elaine_support: I'll propose the workaround while engineering digs in. Also offered to open a priority ticket and share a handful of before/after pairs to run through our regression tests. :memo:

jitendra_prod: Action items: (1) Marco to run repro and diff generation configs by EOD, (2) I'll check release diffs for any sampling/eos changes, (3) Support to collect 5 full request/response pairs. If it's high-impact we can flip the canary back.

maria_support: Assigned SUP-4217 for tracking. Tagging @marco_eng @jitendra_prod — please update this thread when you have the repro results.

marco_eng: On it — will post repro artifacts here. :mag:
